name: Wichita County, TX
findings: Wichita County has 391 nonprofit organizations. 156 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 131 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Wichita County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
